fresh_isolation.rule: R14 primary development may instantiate dev:736..767 only. Confirmation dev:768..799 and fresh:280..319 remain unopened until an exact selected deterministic config is frozen.

mechanism.causal_model: exact accepted R11 public causal version space; only unanimous certified next-state predictions are usable
mechanism.belief_tree: after each hypothetical certified action, partition the current public goal posterior by the progress/distance observation that would be revealed, then optimize future action separately inside each observation branch
mechanism.difference_from_r11: R11 searches state trajectories with a fixed posterior; R14 searches a small public belief-state tree whose branches model future progress feedback
mechanism.guard_expected_worst: candidate first action may not worsen either expected or worst immediate distance relative to the accepted R11 reference
mechanism.guard_pareto_current: candidate first action may not worsen any surviving public goal hypothesis relative to current state

rule: evaluate accepted R11 and all R14 candidates on dev:736..767 only
candidate must strictly improve implicit_goal_regimes solved count versus accepted R11
candidate must strictly improve total solved count versus accepted R11
conditional_regimes, regime_switch and causal_prerequisites solved counts must equal accepted R11 exactly
among eligible candidates maximize implicit_goal_regimes solved

claim_boundary: R14 is development-only. It adds no learned parameters. It may use only public goal posterior, accepted R11 causal certificates, and public transition memory; otherwise it falls back exactly to accepted R11.
